manifest.description: Diagnose Rust constructors, builders, or initialization functions that cross domain boundaries without owning that integration seam.
when_to_use: one constructor or builder initializes unrelated domains because they share a crate address
module dependency graphs signal wiring that might be accidental rather than intentional
a correction plan may split builders, introduce a facade, or repartition an impl
anti_patterns: do not use for constructor size alone
do not use when the wiring function is the documented integration owner
do not assume rust-split-god-impl handles cross-domain wiring; that atom partitions impl methods, not builders
do not use on non-Rust targets
